tail:
Batch 40 is authored as 14 draft items: 10 on the A page and 4 on the B page. I added a local Cauchy probability law with a normalization proof, and aligned the ESS procedure with the paper’s split-chain, antithetic-truncation, and short-chain conventions. The [official bulk-ESS reference](https://mc-stan.org/posterior/reference/ess_bulk.html) confirms the split-chain definition; the [v5 paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1903.08008v5) supplies the estimator details.

**Scoped checks passed:** 14/14 proof contracts; 14 items and 18 proof steps in proof-layout; 4 proof-bearing items in precheck; 16 files in rendercheck; focused dependency checks; and coverage checks with 33 harvested results. All 4 source URLs are fetch-verified.

**Step-1 status:** all 14 items are recorded as escalated. The assigned manifest requires batch 36 and batch 39, while the controlling BCS-37 design specifies BCS-32/33 and says adaptation is not a mathematical prerequisite. The inspected batch-36 CLT theorem still says its imported criteria are unproved locally; the batch-39 theorem establishes marginal convergence only. Owner reconciliation is needed before those page requirements can be considered complete.

The shared batch graph is stale and needs an owner update for the new batch-6 Beta dependency. The run-wide item-level check also reports stale labels on five unrelated Gaussian-process items; none were edited. Details and exact evidence are in the notes.
